m1-jacobian.imperative: Add cda_jacobian: np.ndarray | None = None field to BrakingViewResult and TractionViewResult (frozen dataclasses, defaulted so existing constructors keep working). Populate it in BrakingView.fit and TractionView.fit with the already-computed J (cda_frontier_jacobian output), currently discarded. Add unit tests confirming the field is populated with the expected Jacobian on a healthy fit.

postconditions.statement: new tests for cda_jacobian population written (test-after; numeric/behavioral module, no red/green split needed) -- manual attest
cda_jacobian populated on both views; braking+traction view tests pass

constraints: do not change production pinning CdA flow

m2-cross-view-module.title: Build src/physics/layer2/cross_view.py (honest fusion + propagation helpers)
m2-cross-view-module.imperative: Create cross_view.py with: cda_jacobian_covariance(sigma_cda, jacobian) -> 2-vector; fuse_dual_cda(cda_pd, sigma_pd, cda_co, sigma_co, shared_rel) -> FusedCdA (cov-aware GLS fusion, Sigma=[[sigma_pd^2,cov],[cov,sigma_co^2]], u=[1,1], falsifiable agreement z, disagreement >= 5-sigma flags illegitimate, non-PSD guarded); propagate_shared_param_variance(total_var_pin, cov_with_shared_pin, sigma_shared_pin, sigma_shared_new) -> tightened variance using ONLY the persisted cross-term (recovers J from cov/sigma_pin^2, no re-fit). Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_cross_view.py covering: cov-aware fused sigma on a correlated pair >= naive-independent AND < smaller component sigma; zero-correlation collapses to naive; 5-sigma disagreement flags illegitimate (mu/sigma None); propagation tightens with smaller shared sigma; zero-coupling propagation is a null (unchanged).

postconditions.statement: test_cross_view.py written first, observed failing (module does not exist yet) -- manual attest

m3-store-wiring.title: Persist cross_view_covariance in estimate_store.record_from_estimate
m3-store-wiring.imperative: Populate cross_view_covariance: cov_cda_a_b/cov_cda_b_b from est.cda_closed.sigma**2 * est.braking.cda_jacobian; cov_cda_a_t/cov_cda_b_t from est.traction.cda_jacobian; fused_cda + fused_cda_z + fused_cda_reason from the honest cov-aware fuse_dual_cda of PowerDrag-CdA and Coast-CdA (ONLY when Coast was independently fit -- not pinned; production estimate_session() always pins Coast so fused_cda stays unpopulated there by design -- null-safe with an explicit reason string otherwise). Update the stale G2 test test_cross_view_covariance_defaults_to_none (now populated with a reason even when unfused) and add new tests: jacobian terms populate + round-trip; fused_cda computed when coast is independent and agrees; fused_cda flagged illegitimate on 5-sigma disagreement.

postconditions.statement: new/updated tests written for the store wiring -- manual attest

constraints: null-safe when a view/Jacobian is absent

m4-monza-demo.title: Non-tautological Monza (Italy) RBR 2023 Q redundancy demonstration
m4-monza-demo.imperative: Build a bounded local demo script under .agent-work/627-unified-basis/g3-implement/ that: loads the real Monza RBR 2023 Q session (store=absolute main-checkout telemetry_store.db path); gets a live PowerDrag CdA fit (cheap raw-signal path, no smoother-HP calibration) and a live INDEPENDENT Coast CdA fit (cda_prior=None, same cheap path); computes the honest fused CdA via fuse_dual_cda using G1 systematic_budget's shared_rel; computes live TractionView cda_jacobian and propagates PowerDrag-pin-vs-fused CdA sigma through cov(CdA,b_t) via propagate_shared_param_variance to show b_t tightens. For BrakingView (expensive smoother-HP path, documented G1 stall risk): attempt ONE bounded <=6min live fit; on stall, fall back to the real stored session_estimates row (C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/physics_estimates.db, Italy/2023/Q/Red Bull Racing) + the documented closed-form Jacobian approximation (J ~= -rho/(2*mass), the SAME form systematic_budget.py already uses) to compute the b_b before/after; state explicitly which path (live vs fallback) was used for each axis. Produce a before/after table: PowerDrag-only pin sigma_CdA vs fused sigma_CdA; b_b, b_t effective sigma before/after; agreement z. Never fabricate -- state the run path used for every number.

postconditions.statement: worktree isolation asserted before any real-data run (py -c import estimate_store; print __file__ under C:\Programs\f1-627) -- manual attest
before/after redundancy table produced with real-scale numbers, run path documented per axis, data/*.db unmodified (git status clean on data/)
